tasks.CalculateCandleShortening: Calculating how many centimeters shorter the candle will be after burning for a certain amount of time based on its initial length and the determined rate.
tasks.CalculateTotalTimeBurning: Calculating the total time the candle burns from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM in hours.
tasks.DetermineRateOfShortening: Determining the rate of shortening per hour, which is given as 2 centimeters per hour.
